class.name: mobileManipulator/SelfBoxFilterPointCloud2
class.description: Removes points falling inside an axis-aligned box fixed to the robot base. Catches self-returns off links that have no collision geometry, which a collision-mesh self-filter cannot remove.

class.name: mobileManipulator/HorizontalRangeFilterPointCloud2
class.description: Keeps finite points within a configurable horizontal distance of the UGV. Intended only for the elevation-mapping input branch.
